roller-coaster.definition: A train of cars that travels quickly along a raised track with steep drops and turns.
roller-coaster.exampleUsage: Dina asks where the roller coaster starts.

ferris-wheel.definition: A large wheel with seats that carries people high above the ground.
ferris-wheel.exampleUsage: The Ferris wheel has passenger cabins around its rim.

drop-tower.definition: A tall ride that lifts people before dropping them quickly.
drop-tower.exampleUsage: The guide lists the drop tower as a vertical ride.

spinning-ride.definition: A ride that turns around and around while carrying passengers.
spinning-ride.exampleUsage: Dina reads the restrictions for the spinning ride.

water-slide.definition: A long slippery chute used for sliding down with water.
water-slide.exampleUsage: The water slide ends in the designated landing area.

log-flume.definition: A water ride in which boats travel through a channel and drop suddenly.
log-flume.exampleUsage: The log flume uses boats shaped like logs.

pirate-ship.definition: A boat-shaped ride that swings back and forth like a pirate ship.
pirate-ship.exampleUsage: The pirate-ship ride swings back and forth.

loop-ride.definition: A ride that turns passengers upside down in a complete circle.
loop-ride.exampleUsage: The park map identifies a loop ride near the entrance.

launch-coaster.definition: A roller coaster accelerated by a launch system rather than relying only on an initial lift hill.
launch-coaster.exampleUsage: The guide distinguishes the launch coaster from a lift-hill coaster.

pendulum-ride.definition: A ride that swings passengers from side to side like a pendulum.
pendulum-ride.exampleUsage: The pendulum ride swings about a pivot.

carousel.definition: A ride with decorated seats that moves slowly around a centre.

bumper-cars.definition: Small cars that people drive into one another for fun.
bumper-cars.exampleUsage: The bumper cars operate in a designated enclosed area.

go-karts.definition: Small motor vehicles raced around a short track.
go-karts.exampleUsage: The park hires go-karts for its supervised track.

train-ride.definition: A ride in which passengers travel in a train around the park.
train-ride.exampleUsage: Dina chooses a train ride around the park.

tea-cups.definition: A spinning ride with seats shaped like teacups.
tea-cups.exampleUsage: The tea cups have cup-shaped passenger seats.

flying-swings.definition: A ride with seats that swing through the air in circles.
flying-swings.exampleUsage: The flying swings hang from the rotating structure.

boat-ride.definition: A ride in which people travel on a boat.
boat-ride.exampleUsage: Dina asks about the boat-ride schedule.

monorail.definition: A railway using a single rail or beam; at a park it may carry visitors between areas.
monorail.exampleUsage: The monorail travels on a single rail or beam.

haunted-house.definition: A building designed to frighten visitors with dark rooms and surprises.
haunted-house.exampleUsage: Dina reads the haunted-house description before deciding whether to enter.

fun-house.definition: A building with funny rooms, mirrors, and unusual paths.
fun-house.exampleUsage: The fun house includes distorting mirrors.

ring-toss.definition: A game where players throw rings over targets to win prizes.
ring-toss.exampleUsage: Dina watches the ring-toss game from the booth entrance.

balloon-dart.definition: A game where darts are thrown at balloons to pop them.
balloon-dart.exampleUsage: The balloon-dart game is supervised by a booth operator.

basketball-throw.definition: A game where players throw a ball into a basketball hoop.
basketball-throw.exampleUsage: The basketball-throw booth has a small hoop.

claw-machine.definition: A machine that uses a mechanical claw to pick up a prize.
claw-machine.exampleUsage: The claw machine contains soft toy prizes.

whack-a-mole.definition: A game in which players hit small targets that appear and disappear.
whack-a-mole.exampleUsage: The whack-a-mole game uses pop-up targets.

strength-test.definition: An attraction or game responding to a hit or pull; it is not a medical or standardized strength assessment.
strength-test.exampleUsage: The strength-test booth is a game, not a clinical measurement.

water-gun-game.definition: A game where players spray water at a moving target.
water-gun-game.exampleUsage: The water-gun game has targets inside the booth.

prize-booth.definition: A stall where winners choose or receive prizes.
prize-booth.exampleUsage: Dina asks the prize-booth attendant about the game rules.

stuffed-animal.definition: A soft toy filled with material that can be won as a prize.
stuffed-animal.exampleUsage: The stuffed animal is a soft toy prize.

giant-teddy-bear.definition: A very large soft toy shaped like a teddy bear.
giant-teddy-bear.exampleUsage: A giant teddy bear sits in the prize display.

cotton-candy.definition: A light, fluffy sweet made from spun sugar.
cotton-candy.exampleUsage: The stall sells cotton candy made from spun sugar.

funnel-cake.definition: A sweet cake made by pouring batter through a funnel and frying it.
funnel-cake.arabicTranslation: حلوى عجين مقلي بشكل خيوط متشابكة
funnel-cake.exampleUsage: Dina reads the ingredient list for the funnel cake.

corn-dog.definition: A sausage coated in cornmeal batter and commonly served on a stick.
corn-dog.arabicTranslation: نقانق مغطاة بعجين ذرة على عود
corn-dog.exampleUsage: Dina asks what ingredients are in the corn dog.

popcorn.definition: Small pieces of corn heated until they burst into white pieces.
popcorn.exampleUsage: The stall serves popcorn in a plain container.

candy-apple.definition: An apple covered with a hard sweet coating.
candy-apple.exampleUsage: Dina sees a candy apple in the display.

churro.definition: A fried dough pastry, often ridged and served with sugar or other accompaniments.
churro.exampleUsage: The menu lists a churro beside other pastries.

soft-pretzel.definition: A soft baked snack commonly shaped into a knot; toppings and shapes can vary.
soft-pretzel.exampleUsage: Dina orders a soft pretzel at the food stall.

ice-cream-cone.definition: Ice cream served in a cone-shaped wafer.
ice-cream-cone.exampleUsage: Dina asks which flavors are available for an ice cream cone.

lemonade.definition: A cold sweet drink made with lemons, water, and sugar.
lemonade.exampleUsage: The stall sells lemonade and water.

snow-cone.definition: Shaved ice covered with sweet flavoured syrup.
snow-cone.exampleUsage: The snow cone is made from crushed or shaved ice.

entrance-gate.definition: A gate where visitors enter an amusement park.
entrance-gate.exampleUsage: Dina meets her friend beside the entrance gate.

ticket-booth.definition: A place where visitors buy or collect tickets.
ticket-booth.exampleUsage: The ticket booth is near the park entrance.

map-board.definition: A board showing rides, areas, and paths in the park.
map-board.exampleUsage: Dina reads the map board to find the restroom.

restroom.definition: A public room containing toilets and washing facilities.
restroom.exampleUsage: Dina asks where the nearest restroom is.

first-aid.definition: Immediate initial care given for injury or sudden illness; at a park the phrase may identify a service point.
first-aid.exampleUsage: Dina asks staff where first aid is available.

lost-and-found.definition: A service point where found belongings are stored and lost belongings can be reported.
lost-and-found.exampleUsage: Dina reports her lost scarf at lost and found.

souvenir-shop.definition: A shop selling gifts and objects to remember a visit.
souvenir-shop.exampleUsage: The souvenir shop sells keepsakes from the park.

photo-spot.definition: A place arranged for visitors to take photographs.
photo-spot.exampleUsage: Dina asks whether the photo spot is open.

stage.definition: A raised area where performers entertain an audience.
stage.exampleUsage: The stage is ready for the evening performance.

fountain.definition: A structure that sends water upward and lets it fall back down.
fountain.exampleUsage: The fountain sends water upward into a basin.

parade.definition: A public procession with performers, music, and decorated vehicles.
parade.exampleUsage: Dina checks the parade time in the current schedule.

fireworks.definition: Devices used in organized displays to create light and sound effects; here the term names the display.
fireworks.exampleUsage: The schedule lists a professional fireworks display.

mascot.definition: A figure or character representing an organization, sometimes portrayed by a costumed performer.
mascot.exampleUsage: The mascot represents the park in its publicity.

stilt-walker.definition: A performer who walks on very tall stilts.
stilt-walker.exampleUsage: The schedule names a stilt-walker performance.

juggler.definition: A performer who keeps objects moving through the air.
juggler.arabicTranslation: مؤدٍّ يتلاعب بالكرات أو الأدوات في الهواء
juggler.exampleUsage: The juggler keeps several objects moving in the air.

face-painter.definition: A person who paints designs on people’s faces.
face-painter.exampleUsage: Dina asks the face painter about the products used.

street-performer.definition: An entertainer who performs in a public place.
street-performer.exampleUsage: The street performer entertains visitors in a designated area.

magician.definition: A performer who uses tricks and illusions to entertain people.
magician.exampleUsage: The magician performs an illusion on stage.

dance-show.definition: A performance in which people move to music.

marching-band.definition: A musical group that marches while playing instruments.
marching-band.exampleUsage: The marching band moves along the parade route.

go-kart.definition: A small vehicle used for racing around a track.
go-kart.exampleUsage: The attendant points out the parked go-kart.

swing-ride.definition: A ride in which seats swing through the air.
swing-ride.exampleUsage: Dina asks about the swing-ride restrictions.

arcade.definition: A building filled with electronic games and machines.
arcade.exampleUsage: The arcade contains several game machines.

photo-booth.definition: A small enclosed space where people take photographs.
photo-booth.exampleUsage: Dina uses the photo booth to make a keepsake picture.

stage-show.definition: A performance presented on a stage.
stage-show.exampleUsage: Dina books a seat for the stage show.

parade-float.definition: A decorated vehicle used in a parade.
parade-float.exampleUsage: The parade float follows the designated route.

ticket.definition: A printed or electronic pass that allows entry to a ride or park.
ticket.exampleUsage: Dina keeps her electronic ticket on her phone.

wristband.definition: A band worn around the wrist to show admission or permission.
wristband.exampleUsage: The attendant checks Dina’s admission wristband.

park-map.definition: A sign or diagram showing rides and paths in a park.
park-map.exampleUsage: Dina uses the park map to find the exit.

souvenir.definition: An object bought to remember a visit or place.
souvenir.exampleUsage: Dina buys a small souvenir to remember the visit.
